title: Copilot Studio Quest
subtitle: Build your first agents in 60 minutes – learn by playing
story: Contoso Coffee runs 120 cafés. Baristas and store managers are drowning in the same questions about shifts, vacation, supplies and broken machines. You just joined the new Agent Builder team. Every level solves one Contoso problem. Earn XP, collect badges and cheat cards, and become a Copilot Studio Hero!
disclaimer: Community workshop tool – not an official Microsoft training. Copilot Studio changes often; check Microsoft Learn for the latest details.
